name: CMR Surgical
description: CMR Surgical (formerly Cambridge Medical Robotics) is a surgical robotics company founded in 2014 in Cambridge, United Kingdom. The company develops the [Versius](/robot/cmr_versius) modular multiport robotic surgery system. In October 2026, CMR Surgical entered into a strategic equity investment and U.S. commercial partnership with [Stryker](/company/stryker), granting Stryker exclusive U.S. distribution rights for Versius and a future option to acquire the company.
